description: MDB: Committed UPDATE/DELETE/INSERT visibility across held cursors: DAO dynaset & snapshot vs ADO server keyset & client static. Phase 1: DAO commits UPDATE(1), DELETE(2), INSERT(5); inspect ADO keyset & static before/after Requery. Phase 2: ADO commits UPDATE(3), DELETE(4), INSERT(6); inspect DAO dynaset & snapshot before/after Idle and Requery. Keeps all pages before, after each commit, and after close.
